description: Version control for swarms of coding agents: many writers, one repository, JSON output, git sync.

labels.name: kind: bug
labels.description: SwarmOps did something wrong, or failed in a way it should not.

labels.name: kind: feature
labels.description: Something SwarmOps should do, or do differently.

labels.name: kind: question
labels.description: A question about using or running SwarmOps.

labels.name: kind: docs
labels.description: A page that is wrong, unclear or missing.

labels.name: area: store
labels.description: Objects, journal, index, refs, recovery, verify.

labels.name: area: cli
labels.description: Commands, the JSON envelope, error codes.

labels.name: area: mcp
labels.description: The MCP server, its tools and the API schema.

labels.name: area: remote
labels.description: Clone, fetch, push, sync and the server.

labels.name: area: install
labels.description: The install script, archives and packages.

labels.name: triage: needs-info
labels.description: Waits on the reporter for a command, an envelope or a version.

labels.name: triage: confirmed
labels.description: Reproduced, or accepted as worth doing.

labels.name: triage: wontfix
labels.description: Will not be changed; the issue says why.

labels.name: triage: duplicate
labels.description: Another issue or pull request covers this.

labels.name: invite: good first issue
labels.description: Small and self-contained; a first contribution fits.

labels.name: invite: help wanted
labels.description: Open to a contributor who takes it.
